copy.curiosityHook: When a calculating stalker deliberately targets the one agent still carrying the weight of Dallas, survival becomes a battle of wills.
copy.description: Haunted by his failure to save Kennedy, veteran Secret Service agent Frank Horrigan returns to presidential protection when an elusive assassin calling himself "Booth" targets the current commander-in-chief.
copy.vibeSummary: Tense, fast-paced political thriller with heavy emotional stakes, demanding engaged focus for an exciting cat-and-mouse duel.
copy.whyWatch: Wolfgang Petersen directs a sharp, high-pressure cat-and-mouse thriller that pairs propulsive action with the heavy emotional toll of long-carried guilt.

allowedMaterial: Frank Horrigan's past failure during the Kennedy assassination
The emergence of a new assassin calling himself Booth
Horrigan returning to protection detail to stop the threat
The premise of confronting past guilt through a current presidential threat
excludedMaterial: Eventual fates of Horrigan, the President, or Booth
Plot twists and specific investigation revelations
